evidence.dominant_driver: ADP weekly hiring stronger than expected, reinforcing hawkish rate pricing

absorption.reason: Release is ~43 minutes old and yields/USD were already elevated on oil/Fed repricing.

evidence.decision_notes: Preliminary high-frequency data; residual edge is smaller because hike expectations are already near fully priced.

immediate.rationale: Most hawkish repricing predates this release; residual 15m edge limited.

next_session.rationale: Next session dominated by Fed decision rather than this preliminary ADP pulse.

15m.rationale: Most hawkish repricing predates this release; residual 15m edge limited.

1h.rationale: Stronger hiring plus high yields can sustain pressure.

4h.rationale: FOMC anticipation and prior pricing reduce persistence.

predictions.counter_case: The Fed hike is already almost fully priced and preliminary ADP may be ignored.
